game_concept: A strategy race set in Coastal Port – Sandbar Crossing, a sandbar at low tide: the deckhand must handle sea serpents while practicing conditionals (if / elif / else). Core idea – Patrol Decision Tree: Program a guard-evasion decision tree using nested conditions.
theme: Coastal Port – Sandbar Crossing: a sandbar at low tide
core_gameplay_loop: Construct a solution, execute it, inspect actual state and outputs, then revise until all mission goals pass.
secondary_mechanics: Hint tokens that reveal one line of code
player_objective: Arithmetic procedures: double every value. Match all 3 streams; preserve their order. Dataset 10, operand 17.
controls: Edit both node programs. IN reads the upstream queue; OUT sends to the next node. Step advances one cycle; Run checks every stream.
win_condition: The executed solution satisfies every output and world-state check.
lose_condition: The available unsuccessful execution checks are exhausted.
assets_style: Shared Kenney CC0 tile and audio assets with deterministic Canvas layouts; assets are not duplicated per game.
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Patrol Decision Tree' (Week 3 slot 15), mission type 'Rival Race', and setting 'Sandbar Crossing'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: Coastal Port
region.mood: sea-shanty accordion with wave and gull ambience

tutorial: Read the objective, fixtures and command reference.
Build the circuit or route, or edit the node/adventure program.
Use Step to inspect state; Run checks the real outputs and goals.
Revise errors before using the remaining execution checks.
source_player_objective: Beat a rival AI to the treasure chest by solving code steps involving cover that move the deckhand forward.
source_win_condition: Player progress reaches 100% before the rival does (rival speed 0.95).
source_lose_condition: The rival reaches the treasure chest first, or lives reach 0.
source_game_title: Patrol Decision Tree – Sandbar Crossing Race
hint: Follow the input through each operation. Compare every output, including negative inputs.
